reason: Owner decision 2026-09-24: maps need import and export of height, cliff, water and other layers, for maps of any format, in the core map module. MK3 does it with the common map-layer operations (map.layers, map.layer-read, map.layer-write in @modkit/sdk/maps): a map codec speaks numbers, the application carries them through a grey 8/16-bit PNG with the one PNG decoder of @modkit/codec-kit/raster (greyGridToPng/greyGridFromPng), and the @modkit/ui/map-layers panel (VS Code stage) exports and imports them; a write is the codec's edit plan. StarCraft II publishes height, cliff level and pathing; layer previews keep rendering through view.render. MK3 is the reference; no MK2 comparison is run.

rows.where: modkit-core packages/sdk/src/maps (map-layer contract), packages/codec-kit/src/raster/png.ts, packages/ui/src/map-layers; modkit-extensions-blizzard starcraft2/modules/map/codecs/package/src/codec.ts (mapLayers) and world-writer.js (grid.set)
